mintAuthority.summary: stUSD has a wrapper-local arbitrary mint authorization path: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE, whose issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) requires no deposit. The immutable 1B MAX_SUPPLY bounds nominal supply but does not prevent durable unbacked issuance. Circle parent exposure remains inherited separately.

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE / issueFromWrapper)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() is gated by MINTER_ROLE and enforces MAX_SUPPLY ceiling.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a) returned true; wrapper() on stUSD returned 0xb4d3c1bb…. Contract source (BscScan) confirms issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY; MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant with no setter.

controls.label: StoneYield DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EIP-7702 EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf) returned true. eth_getCode on that address returned 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation designator (0xef0100 + 20-byte target 0x63c0c19a282a1b52b07dd5a65b58948a07dae32b); it is an EOA with EIP-7702 delegation. grantRole() is controlled by this EOA.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0xb4d3c1bb…) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e…) = true. wrapper() returns 0xb4d3c1bb… confirming the on-chain wrapper address. 0x9ab82f8e… is a 23-byte EIP-7702 EOA (delegation designator, not a Safe). MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B tokens (immutable constant). StoneYield docs confirm deposit mint path and admin rewardMint/pause/adminUnlock/sweepUSDC; base USDC mint authority is inherited from Circle because stUSD is tracked as a USDC strategy wrapper. 2026-07-20 dc-1 pass: the wrapper's stUSD issuance is deposit-issued (issueFromWrapper) with canRaiseCap=false and no separate cap-raise authority, so the reviewed economic mint cap is bounded. Upgrade-authority follow-up (2026-07-21): both the mint-critical stUSD token (0x806dd21af6de051fb811760a5768d04a99160eb9) and its MINTER_ROLE-holding wrapper (0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a) return zero at the EIP-1967 implementation and admin storage slots at BSC block 111254044, i.e. neither is a proxy, both are directly-deployed, non-upgradeable contracts, so stUSD's own mint logic cannot be swapped via a proxy upgrade. (The separately referenced sUSDC deposit-asset proxy, 0xad66385c6db496258771b5fd8ac376e3dd0d1536, is a transparent proxy with implementation 0xe1bf9310f23db3fd05931aa89879d5247bb2a678 and admin 0x6158905db12bc51f01542048546f4ca14a7caa80, this governs the underlying collateral token, not stUSD's own mint path.) Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable wrapper minting is capped by the fixed 1B maximum, local reconciliation is not applicable, and no local attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03: D14 correction at BSC block 125056043 (hash 0xd7176228973022a09c22ff423dc34b79ad5ffb371d33f7d06206b7ad3a529e51): Sourcify exact-matched STUSD runtime proves issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) requires only MINTER_ROLE and MAX_SUPPLY, not a deposit or collateral transfer. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf)=true and getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE)=DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. This administrator can grant itself MINTER_ROLE and mint durable unbacked stUSD directly to any recipient up to the fixed 1B maximum. A finite token ceiling is not a collateral-backed issuance boundary under D14; economicCapSemantics is unbounded. No governed-only root is claimed; not-applicable reconciliation and no supervision derive unbounded-unreconciled. Parent Circle issuance remains a separate dependency exposure. Verified source: https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/56/0x806dd21af6de051fb811760a5768d04a99160eb9?fields=all.
